about.title: Vacaville Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a death in Vacaville is caused by someone else's carelessness, the family left behind has to grieve and sort out what comes next at the same time. Public records for 2025 list 335 injury collisions across the city, with 463 people hurt and one traffic death. Behind that single number is a household in Solano County that lost someone. Fatal losses here are not limited to crashes on I-80 or Alamo Drive; they can also follow a fall on someone's property, a defective product, or medical care that went wrong. California treats wrongful death as a civil action, separate from any criminal charges the district attorney pursues. Standing belongs first to a spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and shorter when a government entity is involved. We handle wrongful death cases directly on a contingency basis, so there is no fee unless you recover.

items.title: Clarity on who can bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. We can explain where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock is watched closely
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks when a city, county, or Caltrans is a defendant. Reaching out early protects your options.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: We handle wrongful death cases on contingency and pursue funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. There is no cost to you upfront.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on I-80 near Vacaville. Who might be held responsible?
items.answer: Responsibility depends on how the collision happened, and there may be more than one party involved. An at-fault driver, that driver's employer if they were working, or a company that maintained a vehicle can all be examined. If a roadway condition on I-80 or a city street like Nut Tree Road contributed, a government entity could be named, which triggers a much shorter deadline to file a claim.

items.question: Is a wrongful death case the same as the criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family, while a criminal case is brought by the Solano County District Attorney on behalf of the state. The two proceed separately, and a civil claim can move forward whether or not criminal charges are filed.

items.question: What does a Vacaville wrongful death claim actually seek to recover?
items.answer: California law allows recovery of funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. The specific losses vary from family to family, and no attorney can promise a particular result. We will review your situation and explain what may apply.
